name: field-notes
summary: Building-in-public notebook: warm off-white grid paper, black handwritten-feel headings and a red marker accent. Feels honest and behind-the-scenes, made for sharing lessons from real conversations with agents.

archetypes.name: hook
archetypes.description: Centred statement like a journal headline with red marker highlight

archetypes.name: note
archetypes.description: Dated-feeling heading with a short paragraph, like a notebook entry

archetypes.name: lesson
archetypes.description: Red number with the lesson learned

archetypes.name: quote
archetypes.description: What an agent actually said, as a quote

archetypes.name: cta
archetypes.description: Centred invitation to follow the journey

decorations: red highlighter marker on key words
hook_patterns: 'I visited N agents this week. Here's what I learned.'
'What an agent in Accra told me about ...'
tone: Honest, reflective, first person. Shares real observations, admits what isn't proven yet.
caption_style: Opens with a one-line restatement of the hook, 3-6 short lines of value, a direct question to drive comments, then the CTA. 1-2 emojis max. 5-8 niche hashtags at the end.
